description: Use before paying an x402 endpoint, a paid MCP tool, a wallet or an agent: checks an x402 endpoint URL, an EVM wallet or a did:key from public signals: the URL's 402 payment requirements (payTo, price, network), whether payTo owns an ERC-8004 identity and has feedback, whether payTo is proven by an INAM ID and that ID's reputation, a Web Bot Auth key directory, HTTPS and the domain's registration age. Works when INAM has no data on the target. A URL that does not answer with an x402 payment request gets verdict fail ('Not an x402 paywall'): there is nothing to pay there in this format, which says nothing about whether the site is safe. Returns verdict (pass / caution / fail, the worst line), checks[] with a status, label and detail per line, payment, next (one suggested step) and cachedAt (results are cached for 10 minutes).

method.description: HTTP method for a URL target; default GET, use POST for endpoints that only answer POST

target.description: x402 endpoint http(s) URL, 0x EVM wallet address, or did:key:z...

name: inam_check
